newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: ING says strong profit growth continues.
newsitem.headline: ING says strong profit growth continues.

text.p: Financial services group ING Groep NV (ING) said on Thursday that results in the first nine months of 1996 showed continued strong growth.
The group earlier announced a net profit of 2.34 billion guilders, up 24.1 percent from 1.88 billion a year earlier.
It said banking pre-tax profits rose 26.9 percent to 1.62 billion guilders for the nine month period while insurance profits increased 16.0 percent to 1.72 billion.
In banking, net interest results rose 13.2 percent, commission income by 35.1 percent and results from financial transactions by 52.7 percent.
In insurance, pre-tax profit from life operations grew 14.8 percent, non-life by 16.3 percent and general insurance by 17.6 percent.
ING said shareholders' equity showed a strong increase of 23.2 percent from December 31 and 41.06 percent from September 30, 1995.

"This substantial increase was especially due to higher prices of the equity investments of the insurance operations, retained net profit for the first nine months of 1996, higher currency exchange rates and the exercise of optional dividends and warrants," the company said.
The result was midway between the range of forecasts of 2.27 billion to 2.55 billion guilders, with the consensus at 2.34 billion.
